decisions.reason: Although the operator requires some electromechanical knowledge outside the firm's metal core, it complements its existing garage door systems and its dedicated website page suggests early traction worth learning from.
Solid wood sectional doors rely on woodworking knowledge unrelated to the firm's metal fabrication expertise, and it is only mentioned on the website, signalling limited early success.
The remote-control operator adds electronics and software far from the firm's fabrication knowledge, and its mere mention suggests insufficient early results to justify further learning investment.

Glazed industrial sectional doors build directly on the firm's existing metal sectional door capabilities, and while only mentioned, the firm can interpret its results and improve the glazing extension.
Insulated glazed industrial sectional doors are a natural extension of the firm's metal door knowledge, allowing effective learning from early results despite the modest website presence.
This glazed industrial sectional door benefits from strong existing knowledge and its dedicated website page indicates robust early performance, making it a clear keeper.
